scope: Standalone rank-slab audit model calling the product Wq block predicate; no producer or FULL tower. Small cases use exhaustive judges; n8000/n8192 use proved band bounds without census.

replay_protocol.source_authority: Each attempt.sources contains the exact gate and the two product headers, including SHA256. Reconstruct those relative paths in a fresh .work_rect_* directory under morsehgp3D_v8/audits/.
replay_protocol.build: Use the recorded compiler executable and flags, replace only the old workspace prefix in argv by the new workspace, retain the pinned readonly Boost include path. Compile each run with its recorded 30s timeout.
replay_protocol.execute: Apply each run.sanitizer_environment. Invoke --selftest, no argument, and --unknown using recorded 20s timeouts. Compare codes 0/2/2, empty stderr and byte-identical selftest stdout to the recorded run. Kill the created process group on timeout; remove only the new scratch directory afterward.
replay_protocol.mutation_scope: Mutation::ClosedBoundary is an executed fault mode of the audit proposer, compiled in the same binary. It is not a separately recompiled mutation of the product predicate.
replay_protocol.counter_scope: Input validation (set uniqueness and separation scans) is paid outside Work. Work is not a complete instruction count. No elapsed time in this receipt is a performance qualification.
replay_protocol.python_optimization: Capture checks use explicit require/if branches, not assert.
